title: fix(plugin-sharing): a share link whose redactFields names no column of the object is refused at mint
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi943RpYVWrqYbqemn2F3hcjD)_
Fixes #29130

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR widens one surface and narrows another, so it takes the `(narrowing)` arm. The widening is one new export on `@objectstack/objectql/core` (`declaredColumnSet`). The narrowing is the share-link mint: a `redactFields` entry naming no column of the object was accepted `201` on `main`, and is now refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with nothing minted (measured below on base and head). The changeset carries the `**BREAKING**` banner with the FROM → TO fix and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Both packages stay at patch. Contract review 6576071712, M1.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：创建分享链接时，`redactFields` 里每个字段名都必须是该对象真实存在的列，否则 400 拒绝，不生成链接；objectql 的 `./core` 多导出一个现成函数 `declaredColumnSet`。
- 为什么改：以前写错一个字段名也照样生成链接，那个字段一点没被隐藏，落地页却显示「已隐藏」，等于把本想藏起来的数据发给了所有持链接的人。
- 风险与回滚：这是一个声明为 BREAKING 的收窄：以前能成功、但字段名写错的创建请求现在会被拒；正确的字段名、空列表、已存在的旧链接都不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-service.ts`（`assertRedactFields` 和它在 `createLink` 里的位置，在权限检查之后）、`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-redact-fields.test.ts`、`packages/objectql/src/core.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/share-link-redact-fields.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ShareLinkService.createLink` checks `redactFields` before anything is written, in two steps. First the shape: the list must be an array of strings. That check runs with the mint's other request-shape 400s (`object`, `recordId`, `emailAllowlist`), before any record is read. Then the columns: each entry must name a column a read of the object serves: the object's field map plus the platform-provisioned columns (`id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`). Otherwise it answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, naming every unknown entry once, and no link row is written. This is the request-shape family the mint already uses (`object is required`, `emailAllowlist is required when audience=email`); no new error code.
- The column check runs after the authority check, so a caller with no authority over the record still gets its `403` and learns nothing about the object's columns.
- An object with no checkable field map gets no verdict, and the list is kept as sent. That is `declaredColumnSet`'s shared rule: `undefined` means no opinion.
- The REST door (`POST /api/v1/share-links`) and the dispatcher twin both call `createLink`, so both answer the refusal with the door's existing envelope. No route edit was needed.
- `@objectstack/objectql/core` re-exports `declaredColumnSet` from `declared-read-columns.ts`. That module says its list is the one every read and write door reads, so the mint asks it too and keeps no copy of the column list.
- Changeset `.changeset/29130-share-link-redact-fields.md` (patch, both packages).

Forced test edits: none. No existing test changed. One ledger row was forced: the new suite's engine double is pinned to the engine's `update`/`delete` dispatch contract (`assertEngineUpdateDispatch` / `assertEngineDeleteDispatch`), so `check:engine-double-contract` asked for its two `pinned` rows in `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (written with `--write`: 0 rows added or grown elsewhere, 0 lost). The same double holds the caller's `limit` and refuses a `where` combinator it does not implement, which is what `check:objectql-double-limit` and `check:where-matcher` ask of a new double.

## Tests

New file `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-redact-fields.test.ts`, 11 cases. The fixture schemas are shaped like the registry's, so `id` is not in the field map:
- an unknown entry is refused: status, code, the entry named, no row stored;
- mixed valid and unknown entries: only the unknown ones are named, deduplicated;
- a non-array or non-string list is refused, no row stored;
- a malformed list is refused before any record is read (the engine sees no `find`), even for a record the caller cannot see;
- a valid entry is minted, and resolve withholds that field from the served record;
- `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` are accepted even when the field map omits them;
- an omitted or empty list still stores `null`;
- no field map: no verdict, the list is kept;
- no authority: `403 FORBIDDEN` comes first and does not echo the name;
- REST door: unknown entry gives `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and stores no row; a valid entry gives `201`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stored links are not migrated.** Rows already holding a name that matches no column keep it. The resolve answer still lists that name among the hidden fields, so the landing page can still claim a name is hidden when there is nothing behind it. Filtering at resolve would mean changing the same list that drives redaction, which risks un-hiding a policy entry, so it is not in this PR. It is raised as an open question in the report.
- No update or edit path exists for a link's `redactFields` (only create, list, revoke and resolve), so the mint is the only place the list enters the store.
- Security-family card: the class is described here in the abstract. The tests use generic fixture names.

<details><summary>Ablation (negative pins)</summary>

Put the old accept back with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, replacing the `assertRedactFields(...)` call with the raw `input.redactFields ?? []`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 hits and the blob from 7db89b579f0c to efb2844eef05. Result: 4 failed and 6 passed (10, at `38ded5e5`, before the round-2 shape pin was added). The red cases were the three refusal pins and the REST 400 pin; the valid-mint, provisioned-column, empty-list, no-field-map and 403-ordering cases stayed green, as they should. Restore: the blob matched HEAD again (7db89b579f0c) and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The test imports the service from `src/`, so no `dist` leg was needed.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `04c61e78` derived 71 commands. All 71 ran on this head and every one exited 0. `--ran` with exit codes recorded: `71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 71 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. This includes `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (exit 0): `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition` — `[BREAKING+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. It also includes `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-empty-changeset`, both exit 0.

An earlier run on `e57ba0d3` found three real reds, all about the new suite's engine double: `check:engine-double-contract` (update/delete not dispatch-pinned), `check:objectql-double-limit` (a `find` that ignored `limit`) and `check:where-matcher` (a matcher that would read a combinator as a field name). Each was fixed in the double, as the gate prescribes; no baseline grew. Two prerequisite exits from that run were cleared before the final run: the teardown-shape self-test's pinned fixture commit was fetched, and the seven unbuilt `dist/` trees that `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads were built.
</details>
